topStories.headline: Amazon Eclipses $3 Trillion in Market Cap on AWS Cloud Beat
topStories.summary: Amazon shares surged 5.3% after Q2 AWS revenue hit $42.2B (beating estimates by ~$1.7B), making it the fifth company ever to top $3 trillion in market value.
topStories.marketImpact: AMZN ↑ 5.3%; AI cloud spending cycle reinforced; Alphabet and Microsoft rallied in sympathy; raises the bar for remaining tech earnings.

topStories.headline: SpaceX's $123B IPO Lockup Expires Today — 911.5 Million Insider Shares Eligible for Sale
topStories.summary: SpaceX's first post-IPO lockup tranche expires August 6, making ~$123B worth of insider shares (68x the typical large-cap lockup) eligible for sale, with further staggered tranches through December.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↓ ~14% ahead of expiry; supply overhang is the dominant near-term driver; staggered tranches through Q3 earnings extend pressure throughout the year.

topStories.headline: US Says Iran Strait of Hormuz Deal Could Come 'Today or Tomorrow' as Oil Plunges 5%
topStories.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent said an interim US-Iran agreement is imminent, involving inbound vessels transiting Iranian waters and outbound ships using Oman's corridor, sending Brent crude down 5.3% to $79.36/bbl.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↓ 5.3% to ~$79/bbl; WTI ↓ to ~$76/bbl; US 10Y yield ↓ to ~4.60% for third straight session; eased near-term Fed rate-hike expectations; equities ↑ broadly.

topStories.headline: Houthis Claim Missile Strike on Saudi Oil Tanker Near Yanbu, Pledge Wider Red Sea Campaign
topStories.summary: Yemen's Houthis claimed a ballistic missile hit on a Saudi tanker in the northern Red Sea near Yanbu — their eighth Saudi tanker targeted since July 22 — and pledged to expand attacks northward as Saudi Arabia reroutes vessels.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↑ ~1% after strike, partially reversing the Hormuz-deal selloff; shipping insurance premiums ↑; oil caught in a tug-of-war between Hormuz optimism and Red Sea escalation.

topStories.headline: Nikkei Surges 3.5% to 66,217 — SoftBank Jumps 13% on Q1 Earnings and ARM Rally
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 2,260 points (+3.53%) to 66,217, led by SoftBank Group's 13% surge after Q1 revenue grew 9% YoY to a record high and after ARM Holdings jumped on AI data-center royalty optimism.
topStories.marketImpact: 9984.T ↑ 13%; broader Japan tech ↑; Nikkei near all-time highs; yen stable near 157/$ limiting currency drag on exporters.

topStories.headline: KOSPI Surges 3.76%, Buy-Side Sidecar Triggered — Samsung +5%, SK Hynix +6%
topStories.summary: South Korea's KOSPI closed at 6,598 (+239 pts) with KRX activating a buy-side sidecar at the open as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led a broad semiconductor rally; KOSPI is now up 100%+ year-to-date.
topStories.marketImpact: 005930.KS ↑ 5%; 000660.KS ↑ 6%; AI chip demand narrative reinforced; HBM supply-chain plays outperformed across the region.

topStories.headline: China's July PMI Contracts Broadly — Factory Activity Falls for First Time Since February
topStories.summary: China's official manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.2 in July (vs 50.0 est.) in its first contraction since February, while non-manufacturing PMI also missed at 49.0 and Caixin manufacturing PMI came in at 50.9 vs 51.5 expected.
topStories.marketImpact: Hang Seng ~flat at 25,880 as weak data offset Wall Street's positive lead; FXI ↓ watch; Chinese optical stocks fell on added US tech restriction concerns; raises doubts about China's recovery momentum.

topStories.headline: US Treasuries Rally as Falling Oil Prices Ease Inflation Outlook for Third Session
topStories.summary: US 10-year Treasury yield fell to ~4.60% for the third consecutive session as Hormuz deal optimism sent oil prices sharply lower, reducing near-term inflation concerns and prompting markets to reassess Fed rate-hike timing.
topStories.marketImpact: US 10Y ↓ to ~4.60%; US 30Y ~5.20%; bonds ↑; FOMC September decision increasingly data-dependent; next key marker is Friday's July Nonfarm Payrolls.
